{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm the cleaning worked
print(f'First 5 cleaned revenue values: {df["revenue_clean"].head(5).tolist()}')

# Check for QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
missing_age = df[df['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f'Number of missing age entries: {len(missing_age)}')"}
